design.purpose: Make a six-pointed paper snowflake decoration for display, using the photographed scissors and one added square sheet.

steps.c: Place the 21 cm square sheet flat.
Fold the top-right corner onto the bottom-left corner.
Fold the top-left corner onto the bottom-right corner.
Fold the top-right edge through the top at 30°.
Fold the top-left edge through the top at 30°.
Cut straight across the wedge's wide end.
Cut a triangular notch from the left edge.
Cut a triangular notch from the right edge.
Cut a small notch near the wide end.
Open the sheet out flat to reveal the snowflake.
